def save_trades(data):
    """Save trades to file."""
    DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data["metadata"]["updated"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
    with open(TRADES_FILE, "w") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
